brief:
Gadi Eisenkot announced the start of intensive negotiations with Likud to form a government, Shehab Wire reported. The move follows recent political developments in Israel's coalition-building process.

Naftali Bennett, meanwhile, reaffirmed his support for a government led by himself and rejected any prospect of Benjamin Netanyahu's return to the premiership. The positions mark a continuing divide within Israeli right-wing politics over leadership and coalition formation.

title: Eisenkot launches coalition talks as Bennett vows to block Netanyahu's return
